# gravitino_views Data Source

Lists all views within a Gravitino metalake, catalog, and schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_views" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  catalog  = "hive_catalog"
  schema   = "example_schema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Read-Only

- `views` (Attributes List) List of views with their details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--views))

<a id="nestedatt--views"></a>
### Nested Schema for `views`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--views--audit))
- `comment` (String) The view comment.
- `name` (String) The view name.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the view.
- `view_def` (String) The SQL view definition.

<a id="nestedatt--views--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `views.audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
